cim: Coherent Has the Photonic Components That Will Drive Artificial Intelligence Connectivity
cim_eredeti: Coherent Has the Photonic Components That Will Drive Artificial Intelligence Connectivity
szoveg_eredeti: Coherent focuses on an unusually broad range of photonics technologies and end markets. While the firm has historically served the data center, communications, and industrial markets in a relatively balanced mix, the growing need for faster, energy-efficient photonics to support artificial intelligence infrastructure is shifting revenue heavily toward the data center.

prioritas.indok: Általános cégelemzés a fotonikai komponensek MI infrastruktúrában betöltött szerepéről.
prioritas.cim_hu: A Coherent fotonikai alkatrészei hajthatják meg az MI adatközpontok jövőjét
